# DeepSeek Harness LeetCode
**Learn algorithms inside DeepSeek Harness: lessons, all of LeetCode Hot 100, a sandboxed judge, and
hms inside DeepSeek Harness: lessons, all of LeetCode Hot 100, a sandboxed judge, and an AI tutor.**
English | 中文
## Why
- **All of LeetCode Hot 100**, plus 8 more classics — each with an original summary, three progressi
ve hints, and an explained solution. Statements stay on LeetCode; every problem links to the officia

l page.
- **A real judge on your machine.** Code runs in Docker with no network. Hidden boundary, ra
ndom, and large cases catch wrong and slow solutions — including design classes, in-place edits, and

linked-list/tree node problems.
- **Lessons before problems.** 16 topics, from hashing to dynamic p
rogramming, each with a worked example you can trace step by step. Then the tutor writes a short che

ck about the lesson, reviews your answers, and decides when you're ready for the practice problem.
-
**Add problems by just describing them.** "3 medium BFS problems I haven't done" — an AI agent find
s them on LeetCode, writes the tests, and adds them only if they pass validation.
## A closer look
Hot 100 — LeetCode's own grouping, with your progress per group

Solve — editor, Run and Submit, hidden tests
Submissions — runtime, memory, and every past attempt
Your record — solved by difficulty, a yearly calendar, streaks, and recent passes

Learn — worked examples you can trace
Hints — direction, key idea, outline, solution
Tutor check — questions written for the lesson, answers reviewed by the tutor (real DeepSeek output)
Also included: an AI tutor chat, spaced-repetition reviews with fresh validated variants, progress b
y concept, and optional daily reminder email.
## Quick start
1. **Install Docker Desktop.** Learn then guides the rest: it can start Docker and download the runn
er images with one click, or run `docker pull python:3.13-alpine node:24-alpine` yourself.

2. **Install the plugin** from `github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode`:

install from GitHub.

3. **Open Learn** in the sidebar. Explanations default to Chinese; switch to English in Learn → Sett
Open Learn** in the sidebar. Explanations default to Chinese; switch to English in Learn → Settings.
Needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3 (tested on 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.3). A default model (
for example, signed in to DeepSeek) is optional: it powers the tutor, tutor-written lesson checks, A
I feedback, and Add problems. Running, judging, written hints, and the lessons' built-in check quest
ions work without one.
Install from the command line on Desktop
Quit Desktop completely, then run its bundled CLI and reopen Desktop:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The repository ships prebuilt files in `lib/`, so installing runs no build script. Pin a commit for
reproducible installs: `github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode#<commit>`.
## How judging works
Every verdict comes from test execution only. Your code runs in a Docker container with no network,
a read-only filesystem, and memory, CPU, and process limits; expected answers never enter the contai
ner. Each suite combines official example inputs with hidden boundary, random, and large cases, buil
t from a reference solution and checked against an independent brute-force solution. A pass means **
"passed local tests"**, not LeetCode acceptance. The optional AI judge adds feedback but can never c
s"**, not LeetCode acceptance. The optional AI judge adds feedback but can never change the verdict.
## Add problems
Practice → **Add problems**. Describe what you want and pick how many (1–5). Progress streams live,
and you can stop at any time; problems already added stay.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy

- Your code runs only inside offline Docker containers.
- With a default model, Submit (unless `agen
ts.judge: false`), hints, tutor chat, reflections, and variant generation send the problem summary a
nd your code to that model through DSH. Lesson checks send the lesson and your answers. Add problems
sends your description and LeetCode metadata, never your code. Each run appears in your Session his

tory.
- Add problems queries LeetCode's public GraphQL API for problem metadata only: no login, no s

tatements, paced requests with a per-run budget.
- Nothing else leaves your machine, except reminder
email if you configure SMTP.
Configuration
The plugin adds two rows to your profile: `learn` (the service) and `learn-ui` (the Remote API and U
I). Override settings in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A patch replaces the row's whole `config`
, so keep `dataRoot`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Data lives in `learn/` under your DSH home (`~/.dsh` by default); Settings can export it as JSON or
s in `learn/` under your DSH home (`~/.dsh` by default); Settings can export it as JSON or reset it.
Real email needs `email.transport: smtp`, `email.liveSendingAuthorized: true`, `email.smtp.host`/`po
rt`/`user`, and the SMTP password stored as the DSH credential named by `email.smtp.passwordRef` (de
fault `DSH_LEARN_SMTP_PASSWORD`). Without implicit TLS, STARTTLS is required.
Limitations
- Docker is required for running code. DSH's own process sandbox only restricts file writes (it allo

ws network access and reading your files), so Learn does not use it as a substitute.
- Reminders are
sent only while DSH is running with the plugin enabled; a missed daily digest is sent later the sam

e day, never on a later day.
- TypeScript submissions have their types removed but are not type-chec

ked.
- The tutor sees only the last ten messages of a conversation.
- While an AI run is active, its

Session briefly appears in the sidebar.
- On Desktop, links in reminder emails point to a local por
t that changes on each launch; use the verification code in the email or set `email.publicBaseUrl`.
